mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES remains deeply depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday shopping trips stay suppressed and retail-and-recreation mobility keeps falling over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than its prior 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES staying below -70 and RESIDENTIAL staying above 30 for the full period.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-on-week drop in TRANSIT below its already extreme level signals fewer discretionary trips overall, which should pull RETAIL_REC down within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 2 points week-on-week from an already sub -85 level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after TRANSIT drops by more than 2 points from below -85.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stabilizes or rises while PARKS and TRANSIT remain very weak, household errand traffic shifts toward necessity trips and away from discretionary retail, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stops falling while PARKS and TRANSIT remain below -80
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM is flat or rising and both PARKS and TRANSIT stay below -80.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of persistently depressed WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates strict containment or remote-work enforcement, and under that regime retail mobility continues to weaken across the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior four weeks while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain near their current depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL keeps rising while WORKPLACES fails to recover, time spent at home substitutes for shopping trips and RETAIL_REC remains below its recent baseline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 33 and WORKPLACES staying below -75.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rebound in PARKS mobility from extremely depressed levels marks improved outdoor activity and leisure circulation, which should spill into higher retail-and-recreation visits within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises at least 3 points from its prior week after being below -85
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the following 14 days after PARKS increases by at least 3 points from below -85.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM weakens at the same time WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain suppressed, it indicates broad demand destruction rather than substitution, which will push RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -55 while WORKPLACES stays below -75 and TRANSIT stays below -85
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT all remain in the stated depressed ranges.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lag threshold on mobility recovery applies once TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stop making new lows; after that crossing, retail activity should begin to recover within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES each rise at least 1 point week-on-week after three consecutive weeks of decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve in the week after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES post a simultaneous week-on-week increase following a three-week decline.
